name: TDC (Therapeutics Data Commons)
notes: Programmatic via PyTDC (no key). Prepared subsets written to data/tdc/<Dataset>.csv (id,smiles,y) by `python -m PALM.data.prepare_tdc`. Harvard Dataverse host was under maintenance at prep time — rerun when back. Loaders: PALM.data.sources.load_tdc.

name: OMol25
notes: Already downloaded (train_4M + val + test tarballs, ~28GB). 115-d structural descriptor cache at _cache/features.npy (9,553,821 x 115) + meta.parquet. Loader subsamples 10k. Raw tarballs git-ignored.

name: Materials Project
notes: Needs a free MP API key: export MP_API_KEY and `pip install mp-api`; loader then pulls <=10k summary docs -> MAGPIE composition features. No key available in this environment, so not downloaded.

name: QMOF
notes: Full 20,372-MOF property table qmof.csv downloaded (21MB); 3.1GB structure JSON and CIF archives intentionally not kept. Featurized by reduced formula -> MAGPIE composition; linker SMILES available for scaffold. Repo: https://github.com/Andrew-S-Rosen/QMOF

name: USPTO (MCR reactions)
notes: 3-reactant multicomponent reactions (rA+rB+rC->product); already prepared. Loaded as an n-D record set via PALM.reactions.load_uspto_mcr; loader subsamples 10k.

name: OpenPolymer26 (OPoly26)
notes: Open Polymers 2026: 6.57M single-point DFT calcs (huge). CC-BY-4.0 on HuggingFace (facebook/OMol25 ecosystem). Not downloaded (size + huggingface_hub needed). Loader load_openpolymer26 activates once a subsample records.csv (id,smiles,y) is placed in data/openpolymer26/.

name: MoleculeNet (proxy organic sets)
notes: Already present (esol/bace/bbbp/... CSVs). Used as always-available organic small-molecule datasets while the TDC host is down. Loader: PALM.data.sources.load_moleculenet.
